what: Adding a frame kind (Witness, for witnessed and covered runs) to the query stack breaks an exhaustive match on frame kinds in function.rs, a file outside the lane's list, so the lane's crate cannot compile without a one-arm edit by another owner.
cost: a hand-off and a non-compiling tree until the main agent applies it
cause: what a frame kind means to each walk of the stack (a cycle member's hand-over, find, recording) is decided by a match at each walker, not by the kind itself
class: a closed enum whose meaning is spread across its matchers, so a new variant touches every file that walks it
prevention: give Kind the predicates the walkers ask (passes_through, records, is_member) and match only there, so a new kind is one file's change
